instruction: Let a more_itertools.seekable be indexed: s[i] returns an item from its cache of items produced so far, the same items s.elements() shows, so s[0] is the oldest cached item and s[-1] the most recently produced one. An index outside the cache raises IndexError (s[0] before anything was produced, s[3] after three items). With maxlen the cache holds only the last maxlen items, and indexing covers just those: after taking 5 items from seekable(range(10), maxlen=2) as strings, s[0] is '3' and s[-1] is '4'.
